intendedUse: first-wave Big Ten basketball interior studies
geometryStatus: chart-informed/manual estimates: NOT surveyed section vertex coordinates or verified seating inventory
notes: Individual structural changes are modeled from published section diagrams and available descriptions. Approximate tunnel locations, bank spans and platform widths must not be presented as official.

indiana.notes: Two opposing side banks and separate balcony banks follow the official 2026–27 seating diagram. Mid-bank notch positions are visual estimates, not surveyed portals.

purdue.notes: Inner sections 01–18 and outer 101–118 form a near-round seating dish. Expanded upper student end positions and inner premium seating are chart-informed. Concourse breaks are estimated. All premium blocks remain seated; no front rows are removed solely because a pricing map marks them white.

illinois.notes: Published seating configuration distinguishes 100 lower, 100 upper/club and 48-sector 200 ring; measured suite and ADA platform polygons remain unavailable.

iowa.notes: Official men’s gameday guide identifies student sections E/K rows 1–9 and G/H/I, plus K–N ADA row 42. Reconstructed portal cutouts remain illustrative.

michigan-state.notes: Documented lower 1–9 bench and 13–28 chair rows with 10–12 omitted; upper 1–13 chairs, 14–19 benches; designated student sections in the 200 level.

wisconsin.notes: Official plan has 101–128 / 201–228 / 301–328, north Nicholas Club, south student sections, band and corner wedges. Overhang offsets are not surveyed. Upper tier decks intentionally cantilever into the radial envelope of the preceding tier; overhang offsets are visual estimates.

ucla.notes: 2026–27 diagram shows rectangular sideline banks, angled corner wedges, 200-level A/B/C subdivisions, media at 215, and student seating at 114–116/120–122. Upper subdivision outline is approximate.

washington.notes: Sections 1–14 continue through the lower and upper row bands, and section 1 entrances at rows 10 and 14 are published. Relative section arcs remain estimates.
